description: [Requires sign-in] Ask benchmark personal-agent personas what they think of a brand and whether they would recommend it for a category. Personas: Muse-style, Instinct-style, Grok Bot-style, OpenAI dots-style, and OpenClaw-style. This tool uses benchmark personas, including the Grok Bot-style persona; these are not live consumer-product sessions. It is not the real Grok read-back on a scan and it is not the agent-rails HTTP check. What Grok tells shoppers on a scan is a real model call via API, checked against the store's pages, not the consumer Grok app. All five cart attempts, Grok included, are ARC browser cart tests. Returns, per persona: mentioned, recommended, which competitors were recommended instead, sentiment, and short quotes, plus next steps. Limited to 8 runs per workspace per day and 12 per network. Free workspaces also share a site-wide daily cap so unpaid runs cannot drain the model budget.

category.description: Product category a shopper would ask about, e.g. running shoes.

competitors.description: Optional competitor brand names to watch for in the answers.

name: ask_agents_about_brand
